name: @agent-marshal/marshal-pi
description: pi extension that connects a pi coding-agent session to the marshal coordination daemon — roster registration, send_message/broadcast/join_room/leave_room/set_status tools, and real-time + per-turn delivery of sibling-agent messages. The pi-native counter
